newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-WINNER OF WOMEN'S WORLD CUP SUPER-G.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WINNER OF WOMEN'S WORLD CUP SUPER-G.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Pernilla Wiberg, the winner of a women's World Cup Super-G on Sunday:

Overall World Cup wins: 17 - Slalom: Bad Kleinkirchheim (1991), Waterville (91), Narvik (92), Steamboat (92), Veysonnaz (93, 95), Morzine (94), Lenzerheide (95), Semmering I (95, 96), Maribor (97). Giant slalom: Lake Louise (91) Super-G: Cortina (94), Lake Louise (96), Bad Kleinkirchheim (97). Combined: Sierra Nevada (94), Lenzerheide (95)

Other feats - Gold medal in giant slalom 1991 world championships. Gold medals in slalom and combination 1996 world championships. Gold medal in giant slalom 1992 Olympics. Gold medal in combination 1994 Olympics.

This winter, Wiberg has her sights set on the overall World Cup trophy, the only major title to have eluded her in over six years on the circuit. Previously a specialist in the technical disciplines, Wiberg can now win in such different disciplines as super-G and slalom. Her hobby is singing and she lives in Monaco.
